requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide three immutable DomainContextBundle values through a production package that depends only on public contract/runtime roots, uses the live catalog/seed/bindings/probes API, stores semantic entries in catalog resources, exports no server or execution state, and authors each relational model with prefix ORM NamedConf on Kunun declarations: flat physical metadata on scalar Fields, relation metadata only on typed navigation Properties, and provider configuration on a DataSource whose declaration name is the sole identity.

case.given: all three reference bundles using canonical model source
case.then: all definitions, bindings, probes, typed Property relations, model sources and complete presets SHALL be valid and frozen
business objects, association, lifecycle, constraint, process, capability and raw resources SHALL be represented without private schema types or a shadow relation graph

case.given: bundle production source, built output and package metadata
case.when: the boundary, canonical-residue guard and build run
case.then: only declared public roots SHALL be imported; old ORM forms, capsule, private, generated-authority, web-server and test paths SHALL be rejected

case.given: canonical bundle source exposed through the server catalog
case.when: the web workbench previews and executes a preset
case.then: the displayed source SHALL remain canonical and the resulting SQLite observations SHALL come from that same loaded bundle

requirement.statement: Every reference preset SHALL remain exact through catalog load and server exposure; sequential and concurrent executions SHALL start from deterministic seed; production server startup SHALL register all three reference bundles while createApp without registrations SHALL remain empty; focused tests, package/root builds, import guards, and protected capsule manifests SHALL pass.

case.given: every preset in all three bundles
case.when: contract parsing, catalog matching, runtime load, server catalog serialization, and HTTP execution run
case.then: the complete request including optional timeline facts SHALL remain semantically identical and directly executable

case.given: the same write preset from each mutable reference domain
case.then: each response SHALL start from equivalent seed and independent execution ids/state

case.given: default createApp and real import.meta.main startup composition
case.then: default SHALL remain empty and production startup SHALL expose event-operations-lifecycle, commerce-operations, and organization-adjustment without importing server code from the bundle package
